If you want to waste your money, this is the only place to go. From the first day until the last day of our 6-night stay, we experienced problems. Despite reporting these issues and them acknowledging them, they refused our requests to cancel the reservation. There's no welcome at the hotel; you have to find your way around on your own. Upon arrival, they gave us a different room than the one we booked, and the room was carpeted and smelled unbearable. We changed rooms, and then went down to the pier by the sea, only to be told, "This is the hotel's property," and then escorted us out. We went to this ultra all-inclusive hotel, but the minibars weren't refilled for three days despite us calling twice a day to ask for water. When we asked for cola at mealtimes, we were told that canned colas were extra. The same food was served for dinner three days straight; the rice pudding was spoiled, and we complained, which the hotel acknowledged. The onion croquettes and potatoes were so unusable you couldn't even put a fork in them; it's unclear how many days they'd been sitting before being reheated. We became afraid to eat there for fear of food poisoning. In the Starbucks area, the cups were rinsed with water and then served again in a filthy state; cleanliness is out of the question. At the à la carte restaurant, we asked for melon, and despite having a melon display case right in front of us, we were told it was out of stock. When I asked why, and pointed out that I could see it, they replied that it takes a long time to prepare. Finding a good sun lounger on the piers is a hassle; you have to search for one yourself. Looking at the reviews on the apps that sell this hotel, I'm shocked and see that the reported satisfaction is a complete deception. I chose this hotel based on these reviews and ratings, and I've been completely disappointed. They don't offer a realistic experience. There's no one in the hotel who cares about you, and if you have a negative review, they won't even look at you. I absolutely do not recommend going to this hotel; it's a complete disaster, and they have a system designed to deceive customers. They ruined our vacation.
